description: Delete a budget category. Destructive and irreversible: the first call only previews, and deleting requires confirm: true plus confirm_name set to the category's exact name. Deleting a category also destroys its budget and rollover history; pass transfer_to to keep its transactions categorised.

category.description: Category name or ID to delete

confirm.description: Must be true to delete. Without it, the tool only previews.

confirm_name.description: The category's exact name, echoed back as a safeguard.

transfer_to.description: Category name or ID to transfer existing transactions to

name: delete_category
